Vivek —

Reviewed Aurora's tracked copy and Vivek's summary. High-level comments below; I'll draft the redline positions for Legal to insert into our OF/Exhibit B.

1) Split billing / multi-entity: We can allow multiple remit entities only if (a) the Order Form explicitly lists each paying entity, (b) the invoice acceptance criteria include the correct PO and remit info, and (c) there's an indemnity carveout clarifying which entity bears breach liability for payments. I will add a clause: "Multiple Paying Entities: Accepted where specified in Exhibit B; each paying entity remains jointly liable for aggregate amounts due unless otherwise agreed in writing."

2) Net terms: I'll note an exception path — we can offer Net 45 for Aurora Health Inc (US) if (i) a credit check is completed and (ii) finance raises a purchase order within 10 days of Commencement. Otherwise default to Net 30. This protects Redwood while being flexible.

3) Taxes / VAT: Recommend Aurora confirm reverse-charge acceptance for EU invoices. If they cannot self-account, we'll add VAT to the invoice and reflect a per-band gross-up in the Pricing Appendix. We'll call out that tax burden follows law and that Redwood will provide tax invoices monthly to the address on file.

4) Misc: PO requirement, payment notifications and invoice dispute window (30 days), early termination credits tied to unused prepaid commit. I'll capture these in redline and send to you and Ben by EOD Wed 8/18.

Attachments: Legal_Position_Summary_Aurora.txt (inline in email below)
